title: Good loft bed, but some shortcomings that prevented this from being 5-Stars...
text:
Good loft bed, but some shortcomings that prevented this from being 5-Stars.... THE GOOD:
--------------
* Very professional product.
* Instructions are easy to understand, but you must be attentive and don't skim, or skip ahead.
* Great space saver if you feel your room is a little small.
* Aesthetically, very modern with rounded corners.
* Built in shelf design, as well as a hanging rod for clothing.

THE BAD:
------------
* Parts of the assemble are so tedious. Your fingers will hurt snapping in a bunch of plastic tabs.
* One of the set screws in the frame came loose, so I couldn't unthread a screw. This should never happen. So I'm not too thrilled that I had to spend 30 minutes fixing it.
* The designers or engineers obviously never used loft beds because if they did, then they would have known to make the ladder comfortable to step on. The round ladder steps were a TERRIBLE choice. You'll need to add foam to it.
* Do all loft beds wobble? I don't know, but this one does.
* Guard rail is about 11" high. My son's mattress is 8" thick. That leaves 3" of protection. I don't feel comfortable with that. We will get him a thinner mattress.

In conclusion... for a such a professional looking product, I was really disappointed in the fact that it wobbles, the fact that I had to fix a loose set screw, and how they put no thought into the ladder design. I will rate this 3-Stars overall.

product_metadata.title: DHP Leroy Closet Storage Loft, Twin, Black Bed
features: Modern industrial design perfect for your guest room or teen’s bedroom.
Strong metal construction with integrated ladder, secured metal slats and full-length guardrail.
Functional under bed space that can be used as a closet with a rod to hang clothes and a shelf for an extra storage area.
Ships in one box. Quick and easy assembly required. Available in multiple colors. 1-year limited warranty.

Product dimensions: 78”L x 39.5”W x 73.5”H. Clearance: 58”H. Weight limit: 200 lbs. for upper bed. 50 lbs. for shelf. 50 lbs. for clothing bar. Net weight: 78.5 lbs. Shipping dimensions: 86”L x 16”W x 9”H. Gross weight: 92 lbs
description: The DHP Leroy Closet Storage Loft Bed is the small space living piece of furniture you never knew you needed. Perfect for bedrooms of any size or style, the Leroy is built with a sturdy all-metal frame that includes an integrated ladder, full-length guardrails and secured slats. Thanks to the support offered by the metal slats, you don’t need to purchase any additional box spring or foundation. What’s more, the Levi’s loft space also features more storage options. First, it includes a rod to offer you much needed additional closet space. Second, it also includes a built in shelf to create additional storage space for toys, books, etc… Maximize your space with the DHP Leroy Closet Storage Loft Bed; available in multiple color options.
